explanation: The theorem is a research-level result. It says that the inertia characters of a Galois representation attached to a newform equal θ or θ∘(·^q) for a cuspidal type θ. It rests on library-specific definitions: CuspidalType.IsCuspidalOfType, GaloisRepAdic, FullLevelTate.Datum, DrinfeldCurve, LocalNewvector, and ValuationSubring.tameCharacter. Its proof is built from many library-internal lemmas. I did not run any searches, since none of these notions are in Mathlib. I judged that Mathlib has no declaration that duplicates this result or gives it in one or two lines.
